what: Output table of `pnpm probe:gpu` on the reference laptop (Windows 11, Intel UHD + NVIDIA RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB), pasted by the owner. One run. Timings are one sample of one simple workload (60 full-frame passes of a 16-step shader at 1080x1920): not performance figures.

reading: The bundled Chromium in headless mode cannot use WebGPU on this machine: no adapter, or the device cannot be created (dxil.dll cannot be loaded).
The bundled Chromium with a real window placed off-screen gets a hardware adapter; with --force_high_performance_gpu that adapter is the RTX 3050.
The installed Chrome in headless mode with the GPU enabled also gets the RTX 3050.
The fixed shader gives the reference pixels on Intel, on NVIDIA and on the software adapter of the development container.
